gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed new diagnosis of GBM according to updated World Health Organization (WHO) classification criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: The primary protocol objective is to assess the impact of substituting pulsed reduced dose radiotherapy (pRDR) for standard radiation therapy in the upfront treatment of glioblastoma (GBM) on disease progression.

Planned for standard adjuvant chemoradiotherapy of approximately 60 Gy of radiation therapy (RT) , or biologically equivalent dose, according to local practice, and concomitant TMZ chemotherapy (75 mg/m\^2 daily)

source_quote.quote: All patients with sufficient tissue must have had tissue submitted for O6-Methylguanine-DNA Methyltransferase (MGMT) promoter methylation determination prior to enrollment.

coder_notes: The investigational intervention is pulsed reduced dose-rate radiotherapy (registered as a device), which is not a pharmacological candidate; temozolomide is standard concurrent/adjuvant Stupp dosing and coded soc_backbone (listed as its two registered interventions). Exclusion reason could alternatively be no_pharmacological_candidate; chosen excluded_intervention_type because radiotherapy is the investigated intervention. MGMT: tissue must be submitted for testing but no MGMT status is required for entry, so coded exploratory_correlative rather than eligibility. 'Updated WHO classification' without IDH or edition stated, so cns5_terminology unclear.
